note: Evaluator-private. Benchmark bug IDs mapped to observation experiment traces. NEVER feed into production.

mappings.title: 合同激活只增加预算预留但不减少可用金额
mappings.evidence: Budget available_amount correctly decreases by total_amount on activate. Budget reserved_amount correctly increases by total_amount. 3/3 independent runs consistent. SUT correctly implements BR-CON-008.
mappings.root_cause_of_old_failure: Related Observer for budget entity was not bound. Oracle received only contract root data without budget fields, defaulted to PASS without evidence.

mappings.title: 取消合同不释放未使用预算预留
mappings.evidence: Budget reserved_amount correctly decreases by unpaid amount on cancel. Budget available_amount correctly increases by unpaid amount. 3/3 independent runs consistent. SUT correctly implements BR-CON-010.
mappings.root_cause_of_old_failure: Related Observer for budget entity was not bound. Oracle received only contract root data without budget fields, defaulted to PASS without evidence.
